paper_metadata.title: Attention Is All You Need
paper_metadata.primary_contribution: Introduces the Transformer, an attention-only encoder-decoder architecture using multi-head self-attention and positional encodings to perform sequence transduction without recurrence or convolution.

prerequisites.name: Encoder-Decoder Sequence-to-Sequence Modeling
prerequisites.description: A general paradigm where an encoder maps an input sequence to continuous representations and a decoder generates an output sequence, typically autoregressively. Widely used in machine translation and other sequence transduction tasks.
prerequisites.why_needed: The Transformer adopts the encoder-decoder paradigm, replacing the encoder/decoder internals with attention-only stacks.

prerequisites.name: Attention Mechanisms (Additive vs. Dot-Product)
prerequisites.description: Attention maps a query and key-value pairs to a weighted sum of values using a compatibility function. Additive attention uses a small neural network; dot-product attention uses scaled inner products enabling efficient matrix operations.
prerequisites.why_needed: Transformer layers are built around scaled dot-product attention, and design choices contrast with additive attention baselines.

prerequisites.name: Self-Attention (Intra-Attention)
prerequisites.description: An attention mechanism where queries, keys, and values come from the same sequence, letting each position attend to other positions to compute contextualized representations.
prerequisites.why_needed: The Transformer relies entirely on self-attention to model dependencies within encoder and decoder sequences.

prerequisites.name: Convolutional Seq2Seq Models (ConvS2S, ByteNet)
prerequisites.description: CNN-based transduction models compute hidden states in parallel across positions with receptive fields that grow with depth. Their path length between distant positions grows linearly (ConvS2S) or logarithmically (ByteNet).
prerequisites.why_needed: Provides the efficiency/long-range dependency baseline that the Transformer improves by reducing maximum path length to constant via attention.

prerequisites.name: Sequence-Aligned RNNs
prerequisites.description: Recurrent models process tokens sequentially, creating long computational paths and limited parallelism, though historically dominant in seq2seq tasks.
prerequisites.why_needed: Transformer removes recurrence, motivating design choices for parallelism and constant path length.

prerequisites.name: Autoregressive Decoding
prerequisites.description: A generation process where each output token is predicted conditioned on previously generated tokens, often enforced by causal masking.
prerequisites.why_needed: The Transformer decoder uses masked self-attention to ensure predictions depend only on past outputs.

prerequisites.name: Residual Connections and Layer Normalization
prerequisites.description: Residual connections add inputs to sub-layer outputs to ease optimization; layer normalization stabilizes activations within layers.
prerequisites.why_needed: Every Transformer sub-layer is wrapped with residual addition and layer norm, enabling deep stacks to train.

high_level_components.name: Token Embedding Layer
high_level_components.description: Maps discrete input and output tokens to continuous d_model-dimensional vectors. Weight matrix is shared with the output projection for efficiency and consistency.
high_level_components.purpose: Provide dense vector representations suitable for attention and feed-forward processing.
high_level_components.input: Discrete tokens (input sequence or previous output tokens)

visual_reference.location_in_figure: bottom of encoder and decoder stacks

high_level_components.name: Positional Encoding
high_level_components.description: Adds sinusoidal position-dependent vectors to token embeddings to inject order information without recurrence or convolution. Uses a spectrum of sine/cosine frequencies to represent positions.
high_level_components.purpose: Enable the model to represent absolute and relative positions for attention to exploit.

visual_reference.location_in_figure: added to embeddings at stack inputs

high_level_components.name: Encoder Stack
high_level_components.description: A stack of N identical layers, each composed of multi-head self-attention followed by a position-wise feed-forward network, with residual connections and layer normalization around each sub-layer.
high_level_components.purpose: Encode the entire input sequence into contextualized representations capturing global dependencies.
high_level_components.output: Contextualized encoder representations for all positions

high_level_components.name: Decoder Stack
high_level_components.description: A stack of N identical layers with three sub-layers: masked multi-head self-attention, encoder-decoder attention over encoder outputs, and a position-wise feed-forward network, each wrapped by residual connections and layer normalization.
high_level_components.purpose: Autoregressively produce output token representations conditioned on past outputs and the encoded input.
high_level_components.input: Position-enriched target embeddings and encoder outputs
high_level_components.output: Contextualized decoder representations for all generated positions
key_properties: parallel within a decoding step over positions

high_level_components.name: Multi-Head Self-Attention (Encoder)
high_level_components.description: Projects inputs into multiple query/key/value subspaces and performs scaled dot-product attention in parallel. Concatenates head outputs and linearly projects to fuse information.
high_level_components.purpose: Capture diverse relationships across positions and subspaces in the input sequence.
high_level_components.input: Encoder layer inputs (queries, keys, values from same sequence)
key_properties: reduces effective averaging via multiple heads

high_level_components.name: Masked Multi-Head Self-Attention (Decoder)
high_level_components.description: Same as multi-head self-attention but applies a causal mask to prevent attending to future positions. Ensures autoregressive property during training and inference.
high_level_components.purpose: Maintain causality so each prediction depends only on known past outputs.
high_level_components.input: Decoder layer inputs (queries, keys, values from partial target sequence)

high_level_components.name: Encoder-Decoder Multi-Head Attention
high_level_components.description: Queries originate from the decoder, while keys and values are the encoder outputs. Allows each decoder position to attend over all input positions.
high_level_components.purpose: Fuse source-side information into the autoregressive decoding process.
high_level_components.input: Decoder queries and encoder key/value memories

high_level_components.name: Position-wise Feed-Forward Network
high_level_components.description: Applies the same two-layer MLP with nonlinearity to each position independently. Different parameters per layer depth; identical across positions within a layer.
high_level_components.purpose: Introduce nonlinearity and per-position transformation after attention mixing.

visual_reference.location_in_figure: second sub-layer in each encoder/decoder layer

high_level_components.name: Residual + Layer Normalization Wrapper
high_level_components.description: Wraps each sub-layer with a residual addition followed by layer normalization (LayerNorm(x + Sublayer(x))). Ensures stable deep training and efficient gradient flow.
high_level_components.purpose: Stabilize optimization and enable deep stacking of sub-layers.

high_level_components.name: Scaled Dot-Product Attention
high_level_components.description: Computes attention weights via scaled dot-products between queries and keys, divides by sqrt(d_k) to maintain stable gradients, and applies softmax to weight values.
high_level_components.purpose: Efficient, parallelizable attention kernel underlying all multi-head attention modules.
high_level_components.output: Weighted sums of values per query

high_level_components.name: Shared Output Projection and Softmax
high_level_components.description: Projects decoder representations to vocabulary logits using a linear layer that shares weights with the token embeddings, followed by softmax to produce next-token probabilities.
high_level_components.purpose: Produce probabilistic predictions over the vocabulary for autoregressive decoding.

high_level_components.name: Autoregressive Decoding Process
high_level_components.description: Generates the output sequence token-by-token, feeding previously generated tokens (shifted right) into the decoder with causal masking to prevent information leakage.
high_level_components.purpose: Enable left-to-right sequence generation consistent with language modeling objectives.
high_level_components.input: Previously generated tokens and encoder outputs
high_level_components.output: Next token prediction and updated partial sequence

high_level_relationships.description: Scaled dot-product attention refines dot-product attention by normalizing with sqrt(d_k) to stabilize gradients. It preserves efficiency while addressing saturation issues.
high_level_relationships.data_transformation: General attention formulation → efficient scaled dot-product kernel

high_level_relationships.description: Multi-head attention extends self-attention by performing several attentions in parallel over different learned subspaces, then combining them.
high_level_relationships.data_transformation: Single-head attention → multi-head parallel subspace attention

high_level_relationships.description: Token embeddings are augmented by adding positional encodings to inject order information before entering the stacks.
Position-enriched embeddings are processed by stacked encoder layers to produce contextualized source representations.
Encoder outputs act as memory keys and values for the decoder’s encoder-decoder attention.
high_level_relationships.data_transformation: Encoder states → key/value memory for decoder

high_level_relationships.description: Target token embeddings are also position-enriched before entering masked self-attention in the decoder.
Each decoder layer contains a masked multi-head self-attention sub-layer to enforce causality.
high_level_relationships.data_transformation: Partial target context → causally contextualized representations

high_level_relationships.description: Decoder layers incorporate encoder-decoder attention to integrate source information.
high_level_relationships.data_transformation: Decoder queries + encoder memory → source-aware decoder representations

high_level_relationships.description: Each encoder layer follows attention with a position-wise feed-forward transformation.
high_level_relationships.data_transformation: Attention-mixed features → nonlinear per-position transformed features

high_level_relationships.description: Each decoder layer includes a feed-forward sub-layer after attention operations.
high_level_relationships.data_transformation: Attention-integrated features → refined features per position

high_level_relationships.description: Residual connections and layer normalization wrap each sub-layer within encoder layers.
high_level_relationships.data_transformation: Raw sub-layer outputs → stabilized normalized outputs with skip additions

high_level_relationships.description: Residual and normalization wrappers are also applied around all decoder sub-layers.
Top-layer decoder representations are linearly projected (weights tied with embeddings) and normalized with softmax to yield next-token probabilities.
Predicted tokens are fed back as inputs (shifted) to continue generation under causal masking.
high_level_relationships.data_transformation: Distribution over tokens → selected next token used as subsequent input

high_level_relationships.description: The attention-only encoder replaces CNN-based encoders by offering constant path length between positions and full-sequence context at each layer.
high_level_relationships.data_transformation: Local receptive fields → global attention-driven context

high_level_relationships.description: The attention-only decoder replaces RNN decoders, enabling parallel computation across positions per time step and shorter dependency paths.
high_level_relationships.data_transformation: Sequential recurrence → parallel masked attention with constant path length

main_pipeline.name: Embedding and Positional Encoding
main_pipeline.description: Convert tokens to vectors and add sinusoidal positional encodings to inject order information.

main_pipeline.name: Source Encoding
main_pipeline.description: Process position-enriched source sequence through stacked attention and feed-forward layers to obtain contextual representations.

main_pipeline.name: Target Contextualization (Masked)
main_pipeline.description: Process shifted target embeddings with masked self-attention to maintain causality.

main_pipeline.name: Cross-Attention Fusion
main_pipeline.description: Fuse encoder memory into the decoder via encoder-decoder attention.

main_pipeline.name: Per-Position Feed-Forward Refinement
main_pipeline.description: Apply position-wise feed-forward networks to refine decoder features.

main_pipeline.name: Prediction and Feedback
main_pipeline.description: Project to vocabulary and softmax to produce next-token probabilities; feed predicted/teacher-forced tokens back into the decoder.

parallel_pathways.description: Parallel attention heads operate on different learned subspaces and are concatenated.
Skip connections add sub-layer inputs to outputs in parallel to the main transformation.

feedback_loops.description: Autoregressive decoding feeds previously generated tokens back into the decoder with causal masking.

key_innovations.name: Attention-Only Encoder-Decoder Architecture
key_innovations.description: Eliminates recurrence and convolution entirely, relying solely on self-attention and feed-forward sub-layers. This shortens the maximum path length between any two positions to a constant and enables high parallelism.
key_innovations.comparison_to_baseline: RNNs and CNNs introduce sequential dependencies or hierarchical receptive fields with longer paths; the Transformer processes positions in parallel with global receptive fields via attention.
key_innovations.expected_benefit: Improved ability to model long-range dependencies and faster training due to parallel computation.

key_innovations.name: Multi-Head Attention
key_innovations.description: Runs several attention operations in parallel on projected subspaces and aggregates them. This counters the resolution loss from single-head averaging and captures diverse relationships.
key_innovations.comparison_to_baseline: Single-head attention provides one mixing pattern; multi-head offers multiple complementary patterns processed concurrently.
key_innovations.expected_benefit: Richer contextualization and better modeling of complex dependencies without increasing asymptotic cost.

key_innovations.name: Scaled Dot-Product Attention
key_innovations.description: Introduces scaling of query-key dot products by 1/sqrt(d_k) to prevent softmax saturation when d_k is large. Keeps the efficient matrix-multiplication implementation of dot-product attention.
key_innovations.comparison_to_baseline: Additive attention is slower; unscaled dot-product can suffer from gradient issues at large d_k.
key_innovations.expected_benefit: Stable training with efficient computation across a range of model dimensions.

key_innovations.name: Sinusoidal Positional Encoding
key_innovations.description: Adds fixed sinusoidal signals of varying frequencies to embeddings to encode token positions. Chosen for potential generalization to sequence lengths beyond those seen in training.
key_innovations.comparison_to_baseline: Learned positional embeddings add parameters and may not extrapolate; recurrence/convolution encode order implicitly but at computational cost.
key_innovations.expected_benefit: Order awareness without recurrence or extra parameters, with potential for length extrapolation.

design_decisions.decision: Use sinusoidal positional encodings rather than learned positional embeddings.
design_decisions.rationale: Hypothesized to facilitate learning relative positions and to extrapolate to longer sequences, with comparable performance to learned embeddings.

design_decisions.decision: Apply residual connections and layer normalization around every sub-layer.
design_decisions.rationale: Stabilizes deep training and improves gradient flow in stacked architectures.

design_decisions.decision: Tie input and output embedding weights.
design_decisions.rationale: Parameter efficiency and consistency between input and output spaces.

design_decisions.decision: Use causal masking in decoder self-attention.
design_decisions.rationale: Ensure autoregressive property so predictions depend only on past tokens.

high_level_summary.one_sentence_summary: The Transformer performs sequence transduction with an attention-only encoder-decoder architecture using multi-head self-attention and positional encodings, eliminating recurrence and convolution.
high_level_summary.paragraph_summary: Inputs and outputs are embedded and augmented with sinusoidal positional encodings. The encoder stack applies multi-head self-attention and position-wise feed-forward layers (with residual connections and layer normalization) to produce global contextual representations. The decoder stack uses masked self-attention, cross-attention over encoder outputs, and feed-forward layers to autoregressively generate outputs. A shared output projection and softmax produce next-token probabilities, which feed the decoding loop. This design yields constant path lengths between positions and high parallelism, improving modeling of long-range dependencies.
high_level_summary.conceptual_analogy: Like a committee of experts (heads) each scanning the entire document to offer different perspectives, then combining their insights to write the next sentence, all while keeping track of where in the document they are.
high_level_summary.key_insight: Global, parallel self-attention can replace recurrence and convolution, achieving constant dependency path length while preserving order via positional encodings.
